definitions.gloss: light gray; pale gray; ash gray
definitions.explanation: A muted, pale shade of gray. Used to describe colors in fashion, design, interior decoration, and nature. Formed with the prefix 薄 (light, thin) added to 灰色 (gray).

examples.japanese: {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a light gray sweater.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄灰色|うすはいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曇|くも}っている→曇る：00723_kumoru⟧。
examples.english: The sky is overcast in a pale gray.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{薄灰色|うすはいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: If you paint the walls light gray, the room feels more spacious.

notes:
Composed of {薄|うす} (light, pale) and ⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧ (gray). Part of the productive {薄|うす}～ color pattern where {薄|うす} lightens any base color.

COLOR SHADE PATTERN:
- {薄|うす}～: light/pale version ({薄青|うすあお}, {薄緑|うすみどり}, {薄紫|うすむらさき})
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧～: dark version (⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧, ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: pale gray sky
- {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧: light gray suit
- {薄灰色|うすはいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to dye light gray

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧: gray — the standard neutral gray
- ⟦{濃灰色|のうはいいろ}→濃灰色：26649_nouhaiiro⟧: dark gray — the darker counterpart
- ⟦{銀色|ぎんいろ}→銀色：05068_giniro⟧: silver — a metallic gray with sheen, whereas {薄灰色|うすはいいろ} is matte
